extraction_notes: Source PDF C41384540__DO2302E-Q.pdf, SHA-256 4f7deaa9915cbc8dbe932abb87b838dfcea46b4fafa923664fea12bed5e2dfe0, verified before extraction.

Extraction method: pdftotext -layout for tables plus manual digitization of Figures 1-6 from 400 dpi pdftoppm renders of page 3. Digitized points are visual reads with estimated accuracy of about +/- half a minor grid division on linear axes and about +/- 10-15% on log axes.
Datasheet carries no revision code or date on the page; identity recorded from PDF metadata (created 2021-03-16).
Electrical characteristics table spans pages 2-3; the VSD body-diode row prints at the top of page 3.
Figure 2 (transfer) does not state the VDS test condition; only TJ = 25 degC and TJ = 125 degC curves are labeled. The 25 degC curve was digitized.
Figure 4 (body diode) 25 degC curve digitized on a 6-decade log current axis; small VSD reading errors produce large current errors at the low end.
Figure 6 capacitance curves anchored to the table values Ciss = 180 pF, Coss = 35 pF, Crss = 25 pF at VDS = 10 V, which the curve reads match.
All capacitance quantities (specs ciss/coss/crss and the three Figure 6 curve y-axes) are encoded in SI farads; the datasheet prints them in pF (e.g. 180 pF -> 180e-12 F).
Figure 1 shows two nearly coincident steep lines labeled 10V plus a 4.5V line; all are ohmic-region-dominated up to 25 A, far above the 2.8 A continuous rating (pulse-test typical curves).
Typical-curve amplitudes (up to 25 A) greatly exceed the 2.8 A continuous / 12 A pulsed ratings; treat curve currents as short-pulse typicals, not operating guidance.
Fixed table typo preserved as printed: 'Drain-Sourtce Breakdown Voltage' (BVDSS row).
No SPICE model or vendor model pack was used; all values come from the public datasheet only.

Additional table facts not covered by spec fields: IDSS max 1 uA at VDS = 19 V; IGSS max +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-12 V; Qg typ 2.7 nC, Qgs 0.4 nC, Qgd 0.5 nC at VGS = 4.5 V, VDS = 10 V, ID = 2.8 A; td(on) 2.3 ns, tr 3.1 ns, td(off) 9.2 ns, tf 2.5 ns at VDS = 10 V, VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 2.8 A, RGEN = 3 Ohm; RthJA 162 degC/W; PD 0.77 W at TA = 25 degC.
